data.description: A vibrant, well-connected community offering luxury living, beaches, and top-tier amenities.

data.answer: Jumeirah 1 offers a high standard of living with a wide array of amenities. The community is well-connected and family-friendly, with numerous schools, healthcare facilities, and recreational options. Residents enjoy the mix of serene beach life and urban living, with close proximity to shopping, dining, and entertainment.

Jumeirah 1 offers a variety of housing options, with 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas available for rent and sale. The area’s well-developed infrastructure and luxurious living spaces cater to those seeking a balanced lifestyle in a prime location.

Popular Buildings in Jumeirah 1

Port De La Mer offers a range of waterfront apartments with stunning views. The community features 1 to 4-bedroom apartments, luxurious amenities such as private beaches, pools, and retail outlets, creating a complete lifestyle experience for its residents.

Sur La Mer provides modern townhouses and villas, designed with contemporary luxury in mind. With spacious layouts ranging from 3 to 6 bedrooms, residents enjoy access to high-end facilities like private beaches, landscaped gardens, and a marina, offering an upscale living experience.

Renting a Property in Jumeirah 1

For those interested in properties for rent in Jumeirah 1, you can find a range of 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments, as well as 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas. These rental options provide modern amenities and are situated in a well-connected area of Dubai, making it ideal for families or individuals. These properties for rent in Dubai offer an exceptional living standard.

Buying a Property in Jumeirah 1

When looking for properties for sale in Jumeirah 1, there are various options available, including 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas. These properties offer ample living space and are positioned in one of Dubai’s most desirable locations. The investment potential of these properties for sale in Dubai remains strong due to the location and amenities offered.

Life in Jumeirah 1 is balanced, offering the perfect combination of serenity and convenience. Residents enjoy easy access to shopping malls, beaches, schools, and entertainment options, making it a desirable place to call home. The area provides a variety of services and amenities that cater to both families and individuals.

Transportation and Parking Spaces in Jumeirah 1

Jumeirah 1 is excellently connected to the rest of Dubai, with Sheikh Zayed Road (E11) just a 5-minute drive away, providing access to other major areas in the city. The community offers private parking in all units, ensuring convenient and secure parking for residents.

Supermarkets near Jumeirah 1

There are several supermarkets near Jumeirah 1, including Al Maya Supermarket, New West Zone Supermarket, and Freshmart Supermarket. These stores are all within a 10-minute drive, ensuring convenient access to everyday essentials.

Shopping Malls in Jumeirah 1

Jumeirah Plaza Mall is a local favorite for shopping, offering a range of retail outlets, dining options, and entertainment. It provides a comfortable shopping experience with a mix of well-known brands and cozy cafés, catering to both locals and visitors.

The Village Mall offers a more relaxed shopping experience, with a variety of boutique stores, dining spots, and entertainment venues. Its family-friendly atmosphere makes it a favorite among residents of the Jumeirah 1 area.

Jumeirah Center, located in the heart of Jumeirah 1, features both international and local brands, offering a comprehensive shopping experience. It also includes dining options, making it an ideal place for a day out.

Schools and Nurseries near Jumeirah 1

Kinderville Nursery, located nearby, offers early childhood education with a focus on holistic development. Al Shorouq Private School follows a British curriculum and serves students from primary to secondary levels. Ice Kids Nursery and Daycare provides quality care and education for young children, fostering an environment of growth and learning.

Churches, Temples, and Mosques in and near Jumeirah 1 Location

There are two mosques near Jumeirah 1, Jumeirah Mosque, which is about 5 minutes away, and Al Farooq Omar Bin Al Khattab Mosque, located at a 6-minute drive..

For Hindu residents, there are two temples nearby, the Shiva Temple, located 15 minutes from Jumeirah 1, and the Shree Cutch Satsang Swaminarayan Temple, located 18 minutes away.
For Christian residents, the Holy Trinity Church is situated about 10 minutes from Jumeirah 1, while the St. Mary's Catholic Church is located approximately 15 minutes away.

Clinics and Hospitals in and near Jumeirah 1

Nearby clinics and hospitals include Mediclinic City Hospital, which is located around 10 minutes from Jumeirah 1, and the American Hospital Dubai, about a 15-minute drive away. These facilities offer excellent healthcare services to residents of the area.

Jumeirah 1 Dubai Location & Nearby Areas

Jumeirah 1 is located close to several other Jumeirah communities, including Jumeirah 2 and Jumeirah 3. It is also near Al Badaa, Al Satwa, and Al Safa, which are all within a few minutes’ drive, offering additional amenities and services to the residents of Jumeirah 1.

Jumeirah 1 offers a variety of amenities, including beaches, parks, and dining options. The area is perfect for those seeking a balance between relaxation and entertainment.

Jumeirah 1 Restaurants

Jumeirah 1 features a variety of dining options, including Taverna Restaurant, known for its Mediterranean cuisine, Grill Bowl Café & Restaurant offering delicious grills, and Shaun the Sheep Café & Restaurant, which caters to families with its casual dining and child-friendly atmosphere.

Beaches in Jumeirah 1

Mercato Beach, located near Jumeirah 1, offers a serene environment for beachgoers to relax and enjoy the coastal scenery. The beach is well-maintained and offers convenient access to cafes and restaurants, perfect for a leisurely day by the sea.

La Mer Beach is a trendy and vibrant beachfront destination near Jumeirah 1. With its modern design, retail outlets, and a range of restaurants, it’s a great place for relaxation and family fun.

Jumeirah Public Beach is a popular destination for residents and tourists alike, offering clear waters and soft sand. It is ideal for swimming, picnicking, or simply enjoying the beautiful weather in Dubai.

Hotels in Jumeirah 1

Jumeirah 1 has several luxury hotels, including Hyatt Centric Jumeirah, Rove La Mer Beach, and Mandarin Oriental Jumeirah. These hotels offer upscale accommodations, stunning beachfront locations, and a range of amenities such as pools, dining options, and spas.

Outdoor Activities, Fitness and Beauty

Jumeirah 1 offers various outdoor activities, such as walking along the beach, cycling, and beach sports. Fitness centers and salons are also easily accessible, providing a variety of options for maintaining a healthy lifestyle and personal care.

Windsor Crescent Attractions and Landmarks

Laguna Waterpark, located within Jumeirah 1, is a popular attraction for families and visitors of all ages. It offers an exciting array of water slides, lazy rivers, and pools, making it a perfect spot for a fun-filled day.

The Green Planet Dubai, situated just a 10-minute drive from Jumeirah 1, is a unique indoor tropical rainforest. It features over 3,000 species of plants and animals, offering an immersive experience that brings visitors closer to nature.

Coca-Cola Arena, also within a 10-minute drive from Jumeirah 1, is a state-of-the-art venue for concerts, events, and performances. With its modern facilities and versatile design, it hosts a variety of entertainment experiences.

Outdoor Activities, Gyms and Salons

Residents of Jumeirah 1 have access to various outdoor activities such as beach volleyball and jogging tracks. The area also features numerous gyms and salons for both men and women, ensuring that fitness and beauty needs are easily met.

Living in Jumeirah 1 offers many positives, including its prime location, family-friendly atmosphere, and abundance of amenities. One point to consider is the area’s relatively higher cost of living, but the convenient location and luxury lifestyle make it well worth the investment.

What types of properties are available in Jumeirah 1?

Jumeirah 1 offers 1, 2, and 3-bedroom apartments and 3, 4, and 5-bedroom villas for rent and sale.

Is Jumeirah 1 well-connected to other parts of Dubai?

Yes, Jumeirah 1 is conveniently located near Sheikh Zayed Road, offering easy access to other areas of Dubai.

What amenities are available in Jumeirah 1?

Jumeirah 1 boasts beaches, restaurants, shopping malls, schools, and healthcare facilities.

Are there any leisure attractions near Jumeirah 1?

Many attractions, such as Laguna Waterpark and The Green Planet Dubai, are within a 10-minute drive from Jumeirah 1.

Are there supermarkets near Jumeirah 1?

Yes, supermarkets like Al Maya, New West Zone, and Freshmart are located within a 10-minute drive.

data.content:
Jumeirah 1 is a sought-after sub-community of Jumeirah, located in the heart of Dubai. Situated along Jumeirah Street (D94) and Al Wasl Road (D92), it offers easy access to other prominent areas in Dubai. The neighborhood benefits from proximity to Sheikh Zayed Road, making it convenient for commuting.

This well-established area is home to a mix of apartments and villas for both rent and sale, offering a diverse range of living options. The area is well-known for its fantastic amenities, including luxurious hotels, pristine beaches, and quality schools, making it ideal for families and individuals.

For those looking to enjoy a laid-back yet modern lifestyle, Jumeirah 1 Dubai presents the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. Whether you're exploring Jumeirah 1 beach or indulging in the area’s dining scene, there’s something for everyone.
